description:
Draws a background or wallpaper at the exact size of a place: YouTube banner, Instagram story, LinkedIn cover, desktop up to 4K here (8K on the web page), phones, video calls, slides.

WHEN TO USE: the user wants a background, wallpaper, cover or banner image for a channel, profile, screen or presentation, or asks what size one of these must be.

HOW IT WORKS: pick `format` (70 places, each with its size and the safe area that every device shows) and `style` (blurred petals, veils and hills; steps; geometry such as arcs, tiles, scales, rays; Hilbert curve; folds). `colors` are 3 to 7 hex colors, first one is the background. The same `seed` draws the same design in every format, so a set matches.

RETURNS: width, height, format (name, ratio, safe_area in pixels of the file), files (png, jpg and webp addresses: download with curl -o; null above 4K), and link (the web page with the same options, to adjust, add a screenshot on top or download up to 8K).

angle.description: Direction, in degrees, for veils, hills, steps, stripes, capsules, chevrons, tides and drape.

colors.description: 3 to 7 hex colors without #, comma-separated, in order: background first, then outside to inside.

format.description: Where the image goes. Examples: youtube-banner, youtube-thumbnail, instagram-story, instagram-portrait, linkedin-banner, linkedin-company, x-header, facebook-cover, meeting-background, slides-16x9, desktop-fhd, desktop-4k, iphone-pro-max, android-fhd, og-image, custom (then width and height).

grain.description: Film grain, in percent. 10 to 20 hides banding in smooth gradients.

scale.description: Size of the shapes, in percent. Smaller repeats more of the pattern.

seed.description: Which variation of the design. The same seed and style give the same design in any format.

style.description: petals, veils, hills (soft blur, macOS-like); steps (flat color bands); arcs, rings, stripes, capsules, tiles, cubes, chevrons, rays, scales, diamonds, squares, truchet (geometry); hilbert, quadtree (fractals); tides, drape (folds).
